newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FRENCH MIDFIELDER BOGHOSSIAN JOINS SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH MIDFIELDER BOGHOSSIAN JOINS SAMPDORIA.

text.p: French midfielder Alain Boghossian said on Wednesday he had signed a four-year contract taking him from Napoli to serie A rivals Sampdoria.
"Being here is a big step up for me," he said on being presented by the club.
Boghossian's contract with Napoli expired at the end of the season and he will pick up around $500,000 a year.
"I liked Sampdoria even before moving from Napoli," he said. "I chose with my heart, many other teams wanted me, mainly in Spain."
Boghossian said he hoped to join French internationals Christian Kerembeu and Pierre Laigle, who play for Sampdoria, in winning a national team place.
